intro: Names are the people in office today. Where the latest general election chose a different person, that change is shown beside the name. Those elects take office in January.
intro_after_switch: Names are the people in office today.

holders.name: Dan Dockstader
holders.notes: Official 2024 winner; not on the 2026 ballot. Also covers Lincoln County.

offices.note: Official 2024 SOS statewide Senate summary totals: Dan Dockstader 8,830. Official 2024 Teton clerk portion: Dockstader 1,475 to 115 write-ins. Official 2024 Lincoln clerk portion: Dockstader 7,355. Also covers Lincoln County. Official SOS district-wide totals are used for this multi-county seat. Off-cycle in 2026.

Official 2022 SOS statewide House summary totals: Andrew Byron 2,235, Bob Strobel 1,681, with official 2022 Teton clerk portion Strobel 938, Byron 873. Also covers Lincoln County.
